## G-01 + G-07  One HR event, one chain of consequences

Fires the instant an **HR-002 Employee Master** record is created - it listens on the same `record-created` webhook the portal hook posts to, and ignores every other form code.

It then opens, with real `DR-...` document numbers:

- **HR-003** Employee Document Checklist
- **HR-006** IT Access Request
- **HR-005** Company Property Handover
- **7 to-dos** on the portal's own board - passport/EID/visa copies, PRO visa application, payroll, email account, induction, probation review and first appraisal

Probation is dated at start + 90 days and the appraisal at start + 365, computed from the join date rather than remembered.

**Needs `n8n_hooks.py` installed in the portal** - see the webhook setup note.

parameters.query:
WITH seq AS (
  INSERT INTO counters (form_code, seq) VALUES ('HR-003', 1)
  ON CONFLICT (form_code) DO UPDATE SET seq = counters.seq + 1
  RETURNING seq
)
INSERT INTO frm_hr_003
  (doc_no, created_at, updated_at, created_by, status, notes, "employee_name")
SELECT 'DR-HR-003-' || lpad(seq.seq::text, 4, '0'),
       to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'),
       to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'),
       'n8n', 'Incomplete', $1,$2
FROM seq
RETURNING id, doc_no;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT id FROM users WHERE lower(COALESCE(full_name,'')) = lower($1) LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT id FROM users WHERE role ILIKE 'Admin%' OR role ILIKE '%Operations%'
       ORDER BY id LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)) AS uid
), rows_to_add AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ($2 || ' - collect passport, Emirates ID and visa copies', '#ef4444'),
    ($2 || ' - PRO: start visa / labour card application',      '#ef4444'),
    ($2 || ' - Finance: add to payroll and open salary record', '#f59e0b'),
    ($2 || ' - IT: create email account and portal login',      '#f59e0b'),
    ($2 || ' - Induction plan and policy sign-off',             '#3b82f6'),
    ($2 || ' - PROBATION REVIEW due ' || $3,                    '#8b5cf6'),
    ($2 || ' - First annual appraisal due ' || $4,              '#8b5cf6')
  ) AS v(text, color)
)
INSERT INTO todos (user_id, text, color, done, created_at, status)
SELECT target.uid, rows_to_add.text, rows_to_add.color, 0,
       to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'), 'To Do'
FROM target, rows_to_add
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM todos t WHERE t.text = rows_to_add.text AND COALESCE(t.status,'') <> 'Done')
RETURNING id, text;
